intent: A cinder-lolita Victorian gown: a thin charcoal circlet with violet-tipped tines and a pale veil above a fitted dark bodice and one bone belt, flaring into a pale ash bell skirt burnt black at the hem with one glowing violet seam, so the high camera reads a slim dark top over a full pale bell widest at the burnt hem.
requests: A translucent or ragged cloth kind of piece for the veil and the burnt hem: opaque Fabric blocks cannot show a thin veil or a torn edge.
A tapered or fanning piece (a wedge that widens downward) so the skirt can flare as one continuous bell rather than stepped tiers.
A thin ring or torus kind of piece for the circlet, so it could be one part instead of four strips.
